thread:
incident-bot: Pager duty alert: SEV-1 — GPU prefill OOMs detected in us-west-2 serving cluster (srv-runtime). Auto-escalation to oncall sam. Runbook: /runbooks/prefill-oom

sam (oncall): got it, joining. brief status?

li-ml: seeing repeated "CUDA out of memory" during prefill on a subset of long-context requests (~>120k tokens/window). Containers restarting with exit code 137. stack traces show alloc spikes on KV cache.

ops-bridge: logs show node flaps on gpunode-12a, three restarts in 7m. Noted high p90 sequence length.

michal: tagging recent deploy? No, last model rollout was yesterday and telemetry aligns with traffic shift at ~1701234500 — a new customer workload with very long prompts ramped.

sam (oncall): immediate mitigations: 1) enable prefill size clamp for /generate route 2) shift long-window traffic to fallback-small-model route 3) pause autoscaler scale-up for affected pool to avoid noisy restarts. Can someone run the commands?

ops-bridge: running clamp now:
```bash
# limit prefill tokens to 64k for now
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/api/v1/config -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"route":"/generate","prefill_max_tokens":64000}'
```
ops-bridge: clamp applied to shard set 3, confirmed returning 200.

li-ml: enabling runtime fallback to quantized variant (q5_0) for requests over 32k tokens to reduce VRAM usage. Applying rollout with 10% initial traffic.

michal: routing rule updated: long-context traffic -> model-q5_fallback. check: mesh routing shows 12% routed.

incident-bot: Automated mitigation: cold-model fallback triggered for 18% of prefill requests.

customer-success: heads-up — one paying customer (acct: greenfin) is likely impacted by truncated responses. Drafting notification: "We detected elevated memory errors; we temporarily clamped very long prompts to maintain availability. We're investigating and will share timeline." Want approval to send now?

sam (oncall): send the short notice now. mention workaround (reduce prompt window or use streaming with shorter prefixes).

michal: collecting heap traces. snippet from container gpunode-12a:
```text
[2026-03-17T22:02:11Z] ERROR runtime: CUDA out of memory. tried to allocate 21474836480 bytes
Backtrace:
  runtime.alloc_prefill_kv +0x34c
  runtime.handle_request +0x1a2
  ..
```

ops-bridge: temporary node isolation: draining gpunode-12a from pool, moving active tasks to hotpool. run: `kubectl cordon gpunode-12a && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets gpunode-12a`

sam (oncall): good. also set short-term circuit breaker so a single tenant can't saturate pool: `rbac route set-circuit /generate tenant=greenfin max_concurrent=4`

li-ml: note — KV cache growth for long sequences is quadratic in some backends; long-term we should add streaming prefill trimming and KV eviction heuristics. filing follow-up ticket: INF-4852.

customer-success: notification sent to acct greenfin with workaround + contact. they replied "thanks, will trim prompt for now". no SLA breach reported yet.

alex (night-oncall): picking up handoff in 20m. any outstanding timers?

sam (oncall): handoff to alex at 1701234800. mitigation applied (prefill clamp + fallback), nodes drained, customer notified. continuing postmortem and capacity plan tomorrow.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> reducing severity to SEV-2. monitoring for 1hr.

alex (night-oncall): acked. I'll watch metrics and escalate if restarts resume.
